scope: R2 exits: App restart during the task prompter, App restart during task dictation, network loss at answer submission

tests.name: restart during prompter
tests.defect: glasses kept the old manuscript; the new process ignored its frames, so the long-press exit opened nothing and the question was never offered again (offered set is durable)
tests.fix: dev46 NewsTele adoption: the task prompter DID is kept durably (prompter_owner, until the 3 min show period); a same-DID frame while idle re-adopts the session, so the exit opens dictation and the show timeout resumes
tests.device: dev46: force-stop 14 s after the prompter, relaunch, 'prompter adopted', long-press opened dictation, confirm card submitted, answer option ok

tests.name: restart during dictation
tests.defect: glasses kept recording until the wearer ended it (stock App acked the stop); nothing recovered the interrupted draft until a voice page opened; question not offered again
tests.fix: dev47 VoiceAnswerRuntime.recoverInterrupted at App start: once loaded and linked, retryCleanup sends the stop for the persisted uuid, marks the draft CANCELLED/VOICE_INTERRUPTED and the question is offered on the glasses once more; dev50: the voice page no longer switches auto-start off on the same question's interrupted snapshot while its own prepare runs (root cause found with dev48/dev49 traces)
tests.device: dev50: force-stop 5 s into capture, relaunch, stop sent ~6 s after relaunch, question re-offered, long-press started capture, answer '选一，恢复后能进入录音。'

tests.name: network loss
tests.defect: voice prepare and REVIEW save required a fresh server read of the original question (TASK_UNAVAILABLE offline)
tests.fix: dev51 TaskHub.voiceRequest: only an unreachable server (UnknownHost/Connect/NoRoute/SocketTimeout) falls back to the last observed copy, still checked answerable; the answer stays awaiting_refresh so the pump verifies it with the server before sending; coded server refusals unchanged
tests.device: dictation online, Wi-Fi off 18:06:52 (cellular unavailable), card submitted 18:06:55, SAVED 18:06:58 offline, Wi-Fi on 18:07:11, server answered once: '啊，选一。已经断网并恢复网络。'
tests.limit: dictation itself cannot run offline: the stock speech recognizer needs the network (VOICE_ENGINE_ERROR right after start); a glasses notice was sent

diagnostics_kept: TurboIOVoice handoff blocked / prepared check / page step logs (dev48-dev49)

cleanup.note: one answered question was consumed locally after revocation (consume_answer); settle questions before revoking

not_verified: glasses Bluetooth disconnect during a card or dictation
